title: Plan Tomorrow Morning
wrap_friend: 你剛剛用簡單英文說了明天早上的安排，並接上一個下一步。
scenario: A friend asks what you plan to do tomorrow morning.
learner_goal: Say a near-future plan with one simple next step.
register_notes: Friendly everyday English. Uses common A2 forms such as going to, then, and around.
support_text: Your friend asks about tomorrow morning. Say what you are going to do first, then add one next step.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: What are you going to do tomorrow morning?
turns.speak: What are you going to do tomorrow morning?
turns.translation: 你明天早上打算做什麼？

friend.hint: The question is about tomorrow morning. Use going to for a simple plan.

choices.surface: I am going to go to the bank.
choices.speak: I am going to go to the bank.

choices.surface: I went to the bank yesterday.
choices.speak: I went to the bank yesterday.
choices.feedback: Your friend asks about tomorrow morning, not yesterday.
This asks for a place. It does not say your plan.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: What will you do after that?
turns.speak: What will you do after that?

friend.hint: After that asks for the next step. Answer with then or after that.

inline_explain.title: going to + verb
inline_explain.explain: Use going to for a plan. Use then to add the next step.

choices.surface: Then I am going to study at a cafe.
choices.translation: 接著我打算在咖啡店讀書。
choices.speak: Then I am going to study at a cafe.

choices.feedback: This suggests a meeting place. Your friend asked about your next activity.
This is about now. Your friend asks about the next step tomorrow.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: So are you free before lunch?
turns.speak: So are you free before lunch?

friend.hint: Before lunch means late morning. You can say around plus a time.

choices.surface: Yes, I am free around eleven.
choices.translation: 可以，我十一點左右有空。
choices.speak: Yes, I am free around eleven.

choices.feedback: The question is about tomorrow before lunch, not yesterday.

choices.surface: Does the bank close at eleven?
choices.speak: Does the bank close at eleven?
choices.feedback: Your friend is asking when you are free.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Great. I will message you at eleven.
turns.speak: Great. I will message you at eleven.
turns.translation: 太好了。我十一點傳訊息給你。

friend.hint: The plan is clear now. Close with a short friendly answer.

choices.feedback: This sounds like ordering food or a product. Here you are confirming tomorrow.
This is a hotel sentence. A short goodbye is enough here.

feedback: Distractors test wrong time, wrong function, and wrong scenario without offering a valid alternate answer.
tts_segments: I am going to go to the bank.
Then I am going to study at a cafe.
Yes, I am free around eleven.
runtime_notes: Fresh EN A2 candidate. Structural checks and two AI semantic review passes completed on 2026-06-14 before metadata promotion.

notes.authoring_policy: Fresh-authored from the neutral A2 brief. KO was used only as schema-shape reference.
notes.a2_boundary: Uses near-future plan plus one simple sequence and time availability; avoids a formal itinerary.
